content: Bẹzalẹl ọmaana Oholiyab
Iwa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben Mosẹs bi,
“Kker e, kaam nkk'Bẹzalẹl nnwa kw'ijinọng kw'Uri, kw'ode nnwa kwa Hur k'efona cha Juda ndekha.
Kaam nkk'ẹ Egwugwuma ch'Ibinọkpaabyi nnanga, ọmaana ekkoji, ọmaana eronga, ttara otzitzin kw'emengkka kpenamkpen osisi,
ifha osi ọtzọhm f'otzetzekha fa gol, ọmaana silva, ttara brons,
f'ọkpaara atza obiro odokha bẹ, ọmaana nchi ọgwagwa, ttara omengkka-tzọhm kpenamkpen osisi.
Ayongi mẹ, kaam nkk'Oholiyab nnwa kw'ijinọng kw'Ahisamak, k'efona cha Dan ndekha bi, ọkhẹ-ẹ ọbọhk. Kaam nkk'amengkkakkaa biphyir emengkka nnanga, cha bẹ atzima asi ọttọhk kpenamkpen fa nkk'ọ ndọhna:
mach'irukhabe, ọmaana Ẹkkọhbhi ch'Echekhi, ọmaana ẹkkọhbhikpa ch'ephyokhi, ttara ekpo py'ẹnya ẹdọdọk biphyir py'ikhira nna,
mach'okpokkoro ttara ekpo py'ẹnana mẹ biphyir, ọmaana ettwikkaang-chi cha gol ọkkakka ọmaana ekpo pyẹ biphyir, ọmaana ijafọhnibe s'insẹns,
ọmaana ijafọhnibe s'ẹnanga ẹkwọmichẹ ọmaana ekpo biphyir py'ẹtzọni chẹ abẹ, ọmaana ọkwakkama ttara ẹnana chẹ,
ọmaana nnya nyokhasẹ, nnya s'awurada s'Aarọn kw'ode ọfọhnẹja, ọmaana nnya sa va pẹ p'ijinọng k'ogbe kwa bẹ asi ọtzọhm f'afọhnẹja,
ọmaana ana pa bẹ am-abyengi ọnọng k'eho, ttara insẹns kw'ọdaami eruk kwa bẹ ahok k'Ibe s'Awurada. Tte bẹ asi idik nna atzor k'eden cha ndọhn-ọ.”
Ẹwọhngkwokhawu
Mẹ wọ, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben Mosẹs bi,

“Ben anọng p'Israẹl bi, bọng akhaambi ahok Nwọhngkwokhawu saam. Ma wọ óde ẹkhọhkha k'ottem kwa kaam ọmaana bọbọng, ttara igbọ s'íkwu k'ororo, ifha bọng aronga bi, kaam wọ nde Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'om-osi bọng awur.

“Bọng hok Ẹwọhngkwokhawu nda, okhuri bi, ch'ede ewu ch'awurada ẹnang bọng. Ọnọng kpenamkpen kw'olukhi ewu nda, bẹ akhaambi afhẹ-ẹ; ọnọng kpenamkpen kw'osi ọtzọhm manda vani m'ewu nda, bẹ akhaambi afhẹ-ẹ.
Iwu izadani rọ sa bọng asi ọtzọhm, yina, ewu nda ch'ettonga izenamfa, ede Ẹwọhngkwokhawu ch'awurada ẹnang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi. Ọnọng kpenamkpen kw'ọsi ọtzọhm m'ewu nda, bẹ akhaambi afhẹ-ẹ.
Mẹ wọ, anọng p'Israẹl ahok Ẹwọhngkwokhawu nda, bẹ ahok ewu nda k'igbọ s'íkwu k'ororo mach'echekhi ch'ewobha maa, ogbe ode.

Ewu nda éde ẹkhọhkha k'ottem kwa kaam ọmaana anọng p'Israẹl maa ipemanitzor, okhuri bi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi otzim iwu izadani osi ẹrọng ọmaana irerek, yina, k'ewu ch'ettong izenamfa ọn-ọkwọbha ọtzọhm, okwokha ọwọhng.”
Mada Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okk'Mosẹs idik nna ọgbaakha okyera k'egbegbeho cha Sinai, ọn-ọtzọkha atza-gbẹgbẹri afa p'asana pa kẹ Ibinọkpaabyi otzima ẹnọhna chẹ ọkkẹr, ọnang Mosẹs.
